headline: Jaipower Power Ventures announces the retirement of its CFO and Company Secretary
hook: Key managerial personnel exit at JP Power
summary: Jaipower Power Ventures has announced the cessation of its Chief Financial Officer and Company Secretary cum Compliance Officer, who are key managerial personnel. The disclosure was made under Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. Such leadership exits in compliance and finance roles require monitoring for corporate governance stability. Retail investors should track subsequent announcements regarding the appointment of replacements.
whats_next: Appointment of new CFO and Compliance Officer
why_it_matters: Key management changes can signal internal restructuring or governance shifts.
